    | text      = I don't think anybody does.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.720
    | text      = I mean, just like, listen, regardless of what you think about the things he's doing, I think he's just a very unlikable guy, especially in the current circumstances.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.200
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.559
    | text      = And so Alex talks about how Trump does not like him and maybe Benjamin Netanyahu is actually behind signal gate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:03.919
    | text      = Oh, that sounds true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:05.279

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:20.039

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:35.159

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:37.440

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:43.000

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:48.399
    | text      = This is an interesting way that Alex has decided to explain the whole situation with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth leaking plans to bomb Yemen in multiple signal chats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:57.440
    | text      = Apparently, he did everything right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:59.159
    | text      = But National Security Adviser Mike Waltz added Atlantic reporter Jeffrey Goldberg to their group chat, most likely because he was being blackmailed by Netanyahu.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:08.200
    | text      = That sounds true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:09.039

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.519
    | text      = This still doesn't explain why Hegseth sent his family messages about the military plans in Yemen, but a guy like Alex doesn't let those kind of details get in the way of his ability to tell a fun, fake story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.320
    | text      = I think that Alex isn't operating off of inside information, but he's intuitive enough to see what's going on in the world and realize that Netanyahu has become way lower of a priority for Trump, this presidency, as opposed to the last one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:48.799

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:54.279
    | text      = And it's pretty easy to see that a huge part of this is because Trump personally has huge business dealings with other countries in the Gulf, like Qatar and Saudi Arabia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:03.879
    | text      = One of these actions is that Trump negotiated a deal with the Houthis to stop bombing Yemen in exchange for them stopping attacking ships and blocking trade routes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:13.240
    | text      = That deal didn't include a concession that they would stop shooting missiles at Israeli targets, and they made it very clear that they intended to continue doing that.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:21.359
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:21.880

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:24.359
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:25.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:25.759
    | text      = After that, Trump's administration negotiated directly with Hamas to get the last U.S. citizen hostage that they had taken released, leaving Netanyahu's government out of the loop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:35.920
    | text      = All of it does add up to the appearance of chilling relations, but I don't think it's political at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.960
    | text      = It seems like it's all about what makes the most sense for Trump in terms of money personally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:47.119
    | text      = The line between his business interests and our foreign policy is really blurry at the moment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:52.519
    | text      = I'm going to refer back to what I said about past behavior being a predictor of future events.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:56.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
